mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT FROM ( SELECT m.* FROM T_MENU m JOIN T_AUTH_MENU am ON m.MENU_NO = am.MENU_NO AND am.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN T_USER_GROUP_AUTH ga ON am.AUTH_CODE = ga.AUTH_CODE JOIN T_USER u ON ga.USER_GROUP_NO = u.USER_GROUP_NO WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId} AND u.USE_YN = 'Y' AND m.USE_YN = 'Y' AND m.VISIBLE_YN = 'Y' ) ORDER BY MENU_LEVEL, MENU_ORDER, MENU_NO

INSERT INTO T_MENU ( MENU_NO, PARENT_NO, MENU_NAME, MENU_URL, MENU_LEVEL, MENU_ORDER, MENU_ICON, MENU_TYPE, VISIBLE_YN, USE_YN, DESCRIPTION, REG_DT, UPD_DT ) VALUES ( #{menuNo}, #{parentNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{menuName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menuUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menuLevel,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{menuOrder,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{menuIcon, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{menuType, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'M'), NVL(#{visibleYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MENU SET PARENT_NO = #{parentNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MENU_NAME = #{menuName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MENU_URL = #{menuUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MENU_LEVEL = #{menuLevel, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MENU_ORDER = #{menuOrder, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MENU_ICON = #{menuIcon, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MENU_TYPE = #{menuType, jdbcType=CHAR}, VISIBLE_YN = #{visibleYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MENU_NO = #{menuNo}
UPDATE T_MENU SET USE_YN = 'N', UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MENU_NO = #{menuNo}
